name: The stranger from the bus stop
source:
You met a cute stranger at the bus stop <3

You were living a boring life until one day you decided to make efforts to be a better person and care a little bit about people. You met a c̶r̶e̶e̶p̶y̶ ̶g̶u̶y̶ at the bus stop and it was kinda weird. After that, numbers appearing on your door and you don't know why. Will a strange encounter at the bus stop turn into a love story? (spoil : no)

[From [url=https://daijubudef.itch.io/the-stranger-from-the-bus-stop]Itch.io[/url]]
